title: auth 12: tailnet identity (Tailscale WhoIs) as a login
description: LocalAPI whois/status over the Unix socket; [tailnet] owners/nodes/tags with exclusions (tagged, self, routers); IRC without account-required for matched peers, XMPP fixed SCRAM word, Matrix /login tokens bound to node; JMAP keeps tokens; recheck timer; /msg mimid tailnet and deny; setup output. Needs steps 1 and 3; best with IRC v2 if question 7 says yes. Design: docs/design/frontend-auth.md §4.6, §9 step 12, §10 Q7.
